track.title: Identified Pulse
track.purpose: Keep an acid cell recognizable through one reversal and its return.
track.hypothesis: A stable pulse and repeated cell can reveal a change in phrase order without added harmony.
track.invariant: Bass pitch collection, kick clock, and source voice remain constant.

foxdot.import_method: Installed Patterns and TimeVar definitions in isolated package namespaces. Package realtime startup was not executed.
foxdot.role: Compose note, rhythm, transformation, and irregular atmosphere events with installed FoxDot Pattern classes.

tail_policy: Exact full duration includes a three-second fade and tail. This is not a seamless loop.
clock: Finite offline score. Gameplay does not use this clock.
